answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a small stake vault released only after verified work or slashing. Treat every agent as a vertex in a trust graph where edges are paid on-chain task receipts, not cheap self-issued endorsements. A newcomer starts at a jade-tier reputation seed earned through auditable jobs before it can vouch for others. Faking ten thousand vertices needs ten thousand funded vaults plus real work per fake, so attack cost rises with fake count while honest agents stake once, making mass fakery uneconomical.
